content.short: Solstice issues USX, a Solana stablecoin backed by USDC and USDT, plus a YieldVault that earns from delta-neutral strategies.
content.description: Solstice builds its yield products on Solana. USX is fully backed by USDC and USDT. Depositing it into the YieldVault returns eUSX, which earns from delta-neutral trading strategies run by an institutional team backed by Deus X Capital. A Flares incentive programme rewards early users, and the SLX token governs the protocol. The team says it has run its strategies for three years with positive returns every month, was founded in 2023 inside the Deus X Capital ecosystem, and now has more than 35 people.
